prompts.title: Forma reciente: victorias, empates y derrotas
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16, 8 seconds. Two presentations. Editorial variant: kinetic typography and rhythmic emphasis. Background GoatLab charcoal #101412. Type in warm white #edf0e6, lime #c5ed74, slate #8ca6bf. Spanish labels: 'Victorias', 'Empates', 'Derrotas', 'Torreense', 'Sunderland'. No statistical axes, no sample claims. Composition: upper three quarters hold two horizontal rows, one per team. Team names enter from opposite edges with staggered letter reveal. The three outcome words pulse in rhythmic sequence, each hit scaling from half width to full width. Slate abstract counters orbit each word. Lime flashes on the word 'Victorias', slate on 'Empates', warm white on 'Derrotas'. Typography uses condensed grotesque for team names, extended sans for headings, tabular figures for values. Camera: slow push-in, micro handheld shake on each beat. Transition: hard cut on beat. Exit: all type collapses to center and fades. Lower quarter reserved for permanent yellow subtitles. Statistical variant: grouped count bars, shared baseline at the origin. X-axis uses Spanish labels 'Victorias', 'Empates', 'Derrotas'. Y-axis unit 'partidos', common scale across all bars. Two bars per category: Torreense in lime, Sunderland in slate. Bars enter from baseline with staggered grow. Values resolved by renderer: {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}}, {{home.losses}}, {{away.wins}}, {{away.draws}}, {{away.losses}}. Source and sample annotation: 'Fuente: Bzzoiro · muestra: {{home.n}} partidos Torreense / {{away.n}} partidos Sunderland'. The sample annotation states both sizes and flags if they differ. Main comparison: paired outcome counts. Emphasis: lime halo pulse on the tallest bar, slate underline on the paired bar. Camera: locked wide with slight parallax on bar labels. Transition: wipe from bottom to top. Exit: axes fade, bars shrink to baseline. Lower quarter permanent yellow subtitles.
